visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with dark grey patches on its head and back is sitting on a light-colored wooden floor. The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking down. The cat looks up at the camera with large green eyes, opening its mouth to meow. (2) A hand enters the frame from the top right and pets the cat on its head. The cat closes its eyes and leans into the hand, appearing content and relaxed. (3) The cat looks away and then back at the camera, meowing again as the hand stops petting it. (4) The cat moves toward a grey upholstered chair and hops onto the seat. It settles into a sitting position and looks back at the camera. (5) The hand reappears and scratches the cat behind the ears while it sits on the chair. The cat meows repeatedly toward the camera. (6) A final pink screen is shown with white text in the center and bottom.
